releaseNotes: v1.0.0 (initial scaffold) -- Not yet publicly released. ParentApp, Sofabaton Integration Bridge (grouping device), Sofabaton Remote (forked from dJOS's community Sofabaton X Series Driver, local button/activity triggers unmodified from the original) and Sofabaton Activity (cloud webhook start/stop) added. Remote-driven Activity state sync -- the fired activity is set on and the previously-on activity for that hub set off, both local-only with no cloud call -- is new and not yet validated against real hardware. Cloud Stop Activity webhook is unconfirmed as a real Sofabaton feature; off() falls back to a local-only state change with a warning if no Stop URL is configured.
author: jdthomas24

apps.name: Sofabaton Integration
apps.description: Manages one or more Sofabaton X Series hubs. Creates a Sofabaton Remote device per hub (local remote-to-Hubitat triggers) and Sofabaton Activity devices per hub (cloud webhook control).

drivers.name: Sofabaton Integration Bridge
drivers.description: Internal nesting-only group device -- gives each hub's Sofabaton Remote device a shared parent so multiple hubs group together in the Devices list. Not user-facing; created automatically by the app.

drivers.name: Sofabaton Remote
drivers.description: Component driver for one physical Sofabaton hub (X1S/X2). Receives local button/activity triggers from the physical remote and drives Sofabaton Activity state sync. Forked from dJOS's community Sofabaton X Series Driver -- see driver header for full credit and changelog.

drivers.name: Sofabaton Activity
drivers.description: Component driver for one Sofabaton activity. on()/off() call Sofabaton's cloud webhook for that activity. syncOn()/syncOff() are called only by the parent Sofabaton Remote device to mirror state locally, with no cloud call, when the physical remote changes activity.
